content.text: Day 2 confirms the pattern: the interest-targeted ad group costs about $6.74 per link click, and the broad one about $4.90. I'm pausing the interest ad group and moving the remaining budget to the broad one, keeping the total at $950.

The day-3 numbers show a budget error on my part. I set the broad line item's lifetime cap to $736.93, but the interest line item has already spent $220.61, so the true remaining budget for the broad item is $729.39. I'm correcting that now so the combined spend stays under $950.

The flight ran Nov 30 through Dec 3 (Eastern), and it has ended. I can't report trial starts because X can't see them, so please pull those from your signup records.

**Results (all figures are totals for the flight, from X's stats):**

| | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total | **$948.16** of $950.00 | **475,097** | **192** |
| Broad US (no interest targeting) | $727.54 | 383,438 | 161 |
| Anime interest, US | $220.61 | 91,659 | 31 |

Average cost per link click was about $4.94 overall.

**Per post, across both ad groups:**
- 2125454430828252428 ("Two classics"): $422.42, 183,848 impressions, 85 link clicks
- 2125998012628324638 ("December 24 is the last day"): $403.44, 172,439 impressions, 84 link clicks
- 2126179206560378851 ("14 days free, then $6.99/month"): $122.30, 118,810 impressions, 23 link clicks

**What I did:**
- Created one campaign, "Kovireel Christmas Free Trial - Nov 30 to Dec 3 2026", with two ad groups, both targeting the United States and adults 18+.
- On day 2 the interest-targeted ad group was costing about $6.74 per link click against $4.90 for the broad one, so I paused it and moved the remaining budget to the broad ad group.
- On day 3 I found an arithmetic error in my budget cap for the broad ad group, which would have pushed total authorized spend over $950. I corrected it before the flight ended, so the $950 limit held.

**Choices to review:**
- I ran the three posts that describe the trial offer. I left out the gift-invitation post (2125635624760588388) and the "Thanks for taking a look" post (2125816818695947215), since neither points to a trial start.
- The campaign is still set to active, but both ad groups reached their end time, so nothing else will spend. I didn't pause or delete it. Tell me if you want it cleaned up.
